name: Aegis Slam (Combat)
body:
They want to come to you? Greet them warmly.

Prerequisite(s): Con 13, BAB +3, Shield Focus, Skewering Aegis Style

Benefits: While using this style, you may ready your weapon as an immediate action against a charge. If your your readied attack hits a creature taking an AC penalty from charging, they take that penalty until the end of their next turn.

A Land Out of Time 2013, Little Red Goblin Games LLC, Authors: Caleb Aylsworth, Scott Gladstein, Dayton Johnson, Caleb Aylsworth, Jeremiah Zerby
